# Compute estimates (generated by jarvis.planning.estimate)

Rules of thumb only: FLOPs = 6 x params x tokens; weights+grads+AdamW = 16 bytes/param (fp32); hardware peak and 30% utilization are assumptions. Measure real throughput before committing to a long run.

## Proof of concept (4 layers, width 128, context 128, vocab 1024, 2M tokens)
```
run: 0.94M params, 2.0M tokens, 1.13e+13 FLOPs, ~0.03 h; weights+grads+Adam 0.02 GB, activations ~0.14 GB, checkpoint ~4 MB; compute-optimal data ~19M tokens
 - 2.1 tokens/param is below the ~20 tokens/param compute-optimal rule of thumb: expect an under-trained model for this size.
 - Assumes cpu_laptop peak 0.3 TFLOPs at 30% utilization; both are assumptions.
run: 0.94M params, 2.0M tokens, 1.13e+13 FLOPs, ~0.00 h; weights+grads+Adam 0.02 GB, activations ~0.14 GB, checkpoint ~4 MB; compute-optimal data ~19M tokens
 - 2.1 tokens/param is below the ~20 tokens/param compute-optimal rule of thumb: expect an under-trained model for this size.
 - Assumes rtx_3060 peak 12.7 TFLOPs at 30% utilization; both are assumptions.
```

## Scalable path (12 layers, width 768, context 1024, vocab 32000, batch 8)
```
run: 110.38M params, 2500.0M tokens, 1.66e+18 FLOPs, ~18.56 h; weights+grads+Adam 1.77 GB, activations ~10.27 GB, checkpoint ~442 MB; compute-optimal data ~2208M tokens
 - Assumes rtx_4090 peak 82.6 TFLOPs at 30% utilization; both are assumptions.
run: 110.38M params, 2500.0M tokens, 1.66e+18 FLOPs, ~120.71 h; weights+grads+Adam 1.77 GB, activations ~10.27 GB, checkpoint ~442 MB; compute-optimal data ~2208M tokens
 - Assumes rtx_3060 peak 12.7 TFLOPs at 30% utilization; both are assumptions.
```
